parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: The rotation blade is the sharp cutting component of the knife, made of stainless steel for durability and sharpness.
parts.Functional_description: It performs the cutting action and can rotate or fold into the base body for safety and portability.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot joint to fold or unfold from the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the handle and housing of the knife, typically made of aluminum alloy for strength and light weight.
parts.Functional_description: It provides grip and houses the rotation mechanism for the blade, ensuring safe handling and control.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while providing a pivot point for the blade’s rotation.
